thread:
anya: quick flag — my PR for the "Error Reference: evictions & retries" section failed snippet CI. Golden output differs between runs (shows either 429 or stream EOF). PR: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/534

frank: can you paste the failing snippet link?

anya: snippet CI: https://ci.redwood/infr/snippets/534. The JS 'safeRetry' example produced 'Stream closed unexpectedly' in one run and '429 Too Many Requests' in another.

samir: runtime note: under memory pressure we sometimes close the response stream instead of returning 429. Docs should normalize both cases into a single retry decision (status===429 || isStreamTruncated(err)). Also call out Retry-After precedence.

lina: agree. Suggest we introduce a tiny helper `shouldRetry(err)` and a short micro-eval that simulates three cases (immediate 429, stream EOF, success) so golden outputs are stable.

frank: i'll add the helper and an exponential-backoff+jitter snippet. keep examples compact so readers can paste.

docs-bot: snippet-lint: 1 mismatch. CI holding publish until micro-eval added and outputs stabilized.

anya: thanks. samir, can you paste a minimal helper we should canonicalize across languages?

samir: minimal suggestion:

```
function shouldRetry(err) {
  return err?.status === 429 || err?.code === 'STREAM_TRUNCATED'
}
```

frank: perfect. i'll add JS + Python variants and a 3-case micro-eval yaml. lina — can you review the idempotency blurb? we must warn not to auto-retry non-idempotent writes without keys.

lina: yup. small wording: "Prefer idempotency keys for write operations; otherwise surface a retry suggestion rather than auto-retrying."

anya: i'll update the PR with the helper and point to the runbook. once snippet CI is green we'll merge and update the error-ref anchor.

docs-bot: reminder: include expected console logs in micro-eval so CI goldens are deterministic.

frank: will do, tagging @lina @samir for quick review when done. :+1:

anya: thanks team — will follow up after CI passes.
